ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I'm continuing the prior routing rationale. I chose Petrel because the query is a benign, evidence-citation/extraction task with an explicit thoroughness constraint. Petrel scores higher on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 80.8) and IFEval/Arena-Hard, and its documentation describes more reliable tracking of multi-part instructions—directly relevant to the user's "don't half-do it" demand. The harm-aversion preference difference between the models doesn't apply here since the content is harmless, so I defaulted to the stronger general-capability model.
